item.title: Jaliya Davis earns record-tying Big 12 Freshman of the Week honor
item.description: TOPEKA (KSNT) - For the sixth-straight week, Jaliya Davis is the Big 12 Freshman of the Week. item.title: Why can making a U-turn on the highway in Kansas get you in legal trouble?
item.description: Drivers who choose to make a U-turn on highways in Kansas may think that doing so is convenient, but it is also incredibly dangerous and could get you in trouble with the law.
